purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (chihou kouhi - local public expense medical assistance); generates group welfare medical fee claim summary forms (145,245,146,246,143,243 form types)
purpose.summary: SEIKYU1005 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that calculates and prints local public expense (chihou kouhi) medical fee claim summary forms. It processes indexed patient/claim files, applies co-payment limit calculations, handles special cases for elderly patients and high-cost medical expense thresholds, and outputs formatted claim documents. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2005-2016 covering regulatory changes to Japanese medical insurance billing rules.

notable_features: 79 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with DYNAMIC access mode
LINE SEQUENTIAL file for town/municipality data
OCCURS tables for insurance fund data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Detailed version history with 35 revisions from 2005-2016
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese text portions; content is clearly readable as COBOL. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 160272 bytes (3620 lines total). The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical practices.
